Confirm nothing beyond the two described fixes appears anywhere — no unrelated reformatting, no touched logic from earlier rounds, no new unrelated story/test.

Confirm this doesn't violate React's rules of hooks (a hook call must not become conditional or moved into a branch — moving *where in the function body* a hook is called, while keeping it unconditional and at the top level, is fine; confirm it's still unconditional and still runs on every render, just relocated a few lines down).

1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Recipe for the PDP colour-swatch group — the "Colour: Bay Blue" label row, and (when there is
5	 * more than one populated colour) the row of ZimmColourSwatch rectangles beneath it. This recipe
6	 * only lays the group out; each swatch's own fill/border/focus styling stays in the sibling
7	 * ZimmColourSwatch atom's own recipe.
8	 *
9	 * Values below are read directly off Figma for this exact component, not estimated — node
10	 * 40000307:13867 ("ColourOptions"), within Zimmermann_Design_System_2026.
11	 *
12	 * Six parts:
13	 *   - `root` — outer vertical flex container: the label row above, the swatches row below.
14	 *   - `label` — the label row ("labelContainer" in Figma): the label-group (the two
15	 *     "Colour:"/name text pieces — laid out via a plain Chakra-prop wrapper in the component
16	 *     itself, not a seventh part here; see index.tsx's own comment for why) plus the pagination
17	 *     controls, right-aligned purely via the label-group's own `flex: 1 0 0` rather than an
18	 *     absolute-position hack.
19	 *   - `labelName` — the dynamic colour-name text specifically (e.g. "Bay Blue"). Gets its own
20	 *     part, unlike the static "Colour:" piece beside it, because it alone carries the
21	 *     Figma-mandated truncation behaviour: "If Label/Colour name is longer, use truncation"
22	 *     (this node's own interaction annotation).
23	 *   - `swatches` — the horizontal row of rendered ZimmColourSwatch children. Once paginated
24	 *     (`isPaginated`), reserves a fixed page-width footprint regardless of how many items the
25	 *     current window actually renders — see its own baseStyle comment below for the layout bug
26	 *     this prevents.
27	 *   - `pagination` — wrapper around the two chevron buttons.
28	 *   - `pageButton` — each individual chevron button (24x24, holding a 16px ZimmIcon).
29	 */
30	
31	/**
32	 * Matches `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` in this component's own index.tsx (Figma's own interaction
33	 * annotation: "Pagination appears if there are more than 4 swatches"). Kept as its own literal
34	 * here rather than imported across files — this recipe stays a self-contained, co-located file,
35	 * the same precedent the sibling zimmColourSwatch.css.ts already sets for a state-dependent
36	 * baseStyle function. If `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` in index.tsx ever changes, update this to match.
37	 */
38	const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
39	
40	/**
41	 * A full page's reserved width: PAGE_SIZE swatches at the atom's own fixed 48px width
42	 * (`--zimm-scale-1200` — see zimmColourSwatch.css.ts's `swatch.width`), with no per-swatch gap
43	 * (`swatches.gap` below is 0, same as the atom's own adjacency). Applied only once paginated —
44	 * see the `swatches` part below.
45	 */
46	const PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH = `calc(${PAGE_SIZE} * var(--zimm-scale-1200))`;
47	
48	export const ZimmColourSwatchGroup = {
49	  parts: ['root', 'label', 'labelName', 'swatches', 'pagination', 'pageButton'],
50	
51	  baseStyle: ({ isPaginated }: { isPaginated?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
52	    root: {
53	      display: 'flex',
54	      flexDirection: 'column',
55	      // 8px between the label row and the swatches row. No background here — background lives
56	      // per-swatch, already handled by the atom's own recipe.
57	      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
58	    },
59	
60	    label: {
61	      display: 'flex',
62	      alignItems: 'center',
63	      // 24px. Matches spacing.xl exactly, so the named step is used rather than the numerically
64	      // identical --zimm-scale-600 alias — see bottomBar.css.ts's own `var(--zimm-scale-xl)`
65	      // usage for the same 24px value elsewhere in this codebase.
66	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)',
67	      // 8px between the label-group and the pagination controls.
68	      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
69	    },
70	
71	    labelName: {
72	      textStyle: 'caption',
73	      color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
74	      // The truncating half of the label-group's two text pieces (the static "Colour:" text
75	      // beside it never truncates — see index.tsx). `flex: 1 0 0` lets it consume the
76	      // label-group's remaining width; `minWidth: 0` is required for a flex item to actually
77	      // shrink below its content size instead of overflowing; the rest is the standard
78	      // single-line-ellipsis triad.
79	      flex: '1 0 0',
80	      minWidth: 0,
81	      overflow: 'hidden',
82	      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
83	      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
84	    },
85	
86	    swatches: {
87	      display: 'flex',
88	      // Non-paginated (<= SWATCHES_PER_PAGE populated colours): sizes naturally to however many
89	      // swatches are actually present. Unchanged, deliberately out of scope for this fix — there
90	      // is no confirmed design value either way for a 2- or 3-colour row's width, so nothing was
91	      // invented here.
92	      //
93	      // Paginated (> SWATCHES_PER_PAGE populated colours, windowed to a fixed PAGE_SIZE-wide
94	      // slice per page): a plain `100%` here resolves against `root`'s own width — but `root` has
95	      // no explicit width of its own, so it auto-fits to its widest child, which is this very
96	      // element. That circular relationship meant the *rendered* width tracked how many items the
97	      // current window actually held (192px for a full 4-item page, 96px for a 2-item final
98	      // page), so `root` — and `label` above it, itself 100% of that same `root` — visibly
99	      // resized between pages. Confirmed directly in a running Storybook: the pagination chevrons
100	      // jumped position between the two pages of the `Paginated` story. Reserving
101	      // PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH regardless of the current page's real item count breaks that
102	      // loop — the footprint stays constant across every page, full or partial. A partial final
103	      // page's unused space simply remains empty to the right: the flex default
104	      // `justify-content: flex-start` already left-aligns the rendered items, so nothing further
105	      // is needed for that.
106	      width: isPaginated ? PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH : '100%',
107	      ...(isPaginated ? { minWidth: PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH } : {}),
108	      // Confirmed directly off the Figma export, not a stylistic default: the 4-swatch example
109	      // measures exactly 192px total width for four 48px-wide swatches (4 x 48, no gap
110	      // contribution) — swatches sit directly adjacent. Do not add a gap here; that would be a
111	      // real deviation from the design, not a stylistic default.
112	      gap: 0,
113	    },
114	
115	    pagination: {
116	      display: 'flex',
117	      alignItems: 'center',
118	      // No inter-button gap value exists in the Figma export handed to this step — left at the
119	      // flex default (no `gap` declared at all) rather than invented. Revisit if a designer
120	      // confirms a real value.
121	    },
122	
123	    pageButton: {
124	      display: 'flex',
125	      alignItems: 'center',
126	      justifyContent: 'center',
127	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
128	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
129	      // Resets the native <button> UA chrome so the box is exactly the 24x24 the design calls
130	      // for, with the 16px ZimmIcon centred inside it by the flex alignment above.
131	      padding: 0,
132	      border: 'none',
133	      background: 'none',
134	      cursor: 'pointer',
135	      // No confirmed Figma spec for a disabled visual treatment on this control — same "leave an
136	      // unspecified visual state alone rather than invent one" precedent as swatch-group's own
137	      // disabled colour logic (see this codebase's Known Gaps notes). The native `disabled`
138	      // attribute (set in index.tsx) already makes the control genuinely inert and announces as
139	      // disabled to assistive tech; only the cursor affordance is set here, which is a UX
140	      // keyword, not a design token.
141	      _disabled: {
142	        cursor: 'not-allowed',
143	      },
144	      // Same uniform ring every other interactive control in ui-kits/ uses (zimmColourSwatch,
145	      // zimmNavItem) — --zimm-focus-ring already composites the border-width/colour pair.
146	      _focusVisible: {
147	        outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
148	        outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
149	      },
150	    },
151	  }),
152	};
153

## Findings

**Branch:** `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches` (confirmed via `git branch --show-current`). Consistent with the task description.

### Full diff inventory (`git status --porcelain`, `git diff --cached`)

```
 M overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts
?? overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/
```

Nothing is staged (`git diff --cached --stat` is empty). The untracked directory contains exactly the four authorized files (`ls`): `index.stories.tsx`, `index.test.tsx`, `index.tsx`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`. No stray files anywhere else.

### Hard stops — all confirmed clean

- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` — `git diff` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. Zero diff.
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/` — `git diff` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. Zero diff.
- `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` — `git diff` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. Zero diff.
- `overrides/app/theme/foundation/` — `git diff` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. Tier 1, untouched.

### Fix 1 — story restructuring (`index.stories.tsx`)

- `Default` (lines 76–93): no `play` function. Comment at lines 83–92 explains the removal (duplicate coverage + a real focus-ring-left-on-load bug). `args` (`label`, `selectedName`, `selectedValue`, `values: [BAY_BLUE, IVORY, BLACK, ROSE_PINK]`) are identical to the new story's `args` — consistent with a clean split, not an incidental fixture change.
- `KeyboardNavigation` (lines 95–117): genuinely new — `Default` still exists as its own story with its original purpose intact, so this isn't a rename. Carries exactly the arrow-key assertions described as moved: `selected.focus()` → `ArrowRight` → asserts focus on Ivory → `ArrowLeft` → asserts focus back on the original swatch (lines 109–115).
- `SingleColour`, `WithUnpopulatedVariations`, `NoneSelected`, `Paginated` stories are present, unrelated to either fix, and show no signs of alteration.

### Fix 2 — `isPaginated` width fix (`zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts` + `index.tsx`)

- `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts:51`: `baseStyle: ({ isPaginated }: { isPaginated?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({...})` — object converted to a function.
- Only the `swatches` part (lines 86–113) is `isPaginated`-conditional: `width: isPaginated ? PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH : '100%'` plus a conditionally-spread `minWidth`. The non-paginated branch keeps the exact prior value (`'100%'`).
- `root` (52–58), `label` (60–69), `labelName` (71–84), `pagination` (115–121), `pageButton` (123–150) are all static `SystemStyleObject`s with zero `isPaginated` reference — confirms only the `swatches` part's width behaviour changed; nothing else moved incidentally during the object→function conversion.
- `index.tsx:134`: `const isPaginated = populated.length > SWATCHES_PER_PAGE;` computed before `index.tsx:142`: `const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_COLOUR_SWATCH_GROUP_RECIPE, { isPaginated });`. Traced every statement from function entry (line 96) to line 142 — `useIntl`, `useRef`, `useState`, `useEffect`, `useMultiStyleConfig` are all top-level, unconditional calls with no early return or branch above them. Rules of Hooks intact; this is a relocation, not a conditional hook.

### New regression test (`index.test.tsx`)

- Lines 169–217, `'reserves a fixed page-width footprint once paginated...'` — the one new test in this file. Asserts `getComputedStyle(...).width` equals `calc(4 * var(--zimm-scale-1200))` both before and after clicking "next colours," and explicitly asserts `not.toBe('100%')` both times (lines 206–207, 216) — a real regression guard, not a tautology. All other tests (AC1/AC5, roving tabindex, recipe registration, truncation, and the *prior* round's "mounts directly on the page containing the actual selection" test at lines 133–167) are present and read as unmodified.

### Previous round's pagination-selection logic — confirmed untouched

`index.tsx` lines 106–132 (`populated` → `selectedIndex`/`selectedPageStart` → `useState(selectedPageStart)` → resync `useEffect`) is present, coherent, and matches its own extensive inline documentation of intent. No sign of reversion or alteration.

### No premature Step 4 coupling

`grep -rn "ZimmColourSwatchGroup"` across the whole repo (excluding `node_modules` and the component's own folder) returns exactly two lines, both in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (the import and the map entry). No page-level or `product-detail`/`product-view` consumer exists.

### Type-check

`npx tsc --noEmit` (read-only) completed with zero output — no type errors anywhere in the repo, including all four changed files and the theme registration.

## One item outside the four-file manifest

`overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` — Tier 2 (`overrides/app/theme/components/`, "Theme Component Styles," owner UI Designer, per `protectedFiles.md`). Diff is exactly two lines:
```
+import { ZimmColourSwatchGroup } from 'app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroup.css';
...
+  ZimmColourSwatchGroup,
```
This file was not named in this round's four-file authorization. However, its content has zero connection to either of this round's two fixes (no `isPaginated`, no width, no story reference) — it is the one-time recipe registration that `overrideStyling.md` mandates for any co-located `<name>.css.ts` recipe ("Either way it's still registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`"), and it is mechanically required for the component to resolve any styling at all via `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmColourSwatchGroup', ...)`. Since Step 3 has no intermediate commits across its three revisions, this line has been sitting in the working tree since the component was first scaffolded — it reads as carried-over baseline from Step 3's original creation, not new work introduced by this rework round. Flagging it per the manifest check, not treating it as this round's over-delivery.

## Verdict

**IN SCOPE** — the four authorized files contain precisely the two described fixes and nothing else: the `Default`/`KeyboardNavigation` story split at `index.stories.tsx:76-117`, and the `isPaginated`-conditional `swatches.width` fix at `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts:51,106-107` wired via `index.tsx:134,142`, with its regression test at `index.test.tsx:169-217`. All four hard stops (`product-view/index.tsx`, `zimmColourSwatch/`, `recipeGuards.test.ts`, `theme/foundation/`) show zero diff. The prior round's pagination-selection logic (`index.tsx:106-132`) is unchanged. No premature Step 4 coupling exists (grep confirms only the theme registration references the component). `tsc --noEmit` is clean. The one file outside the literal four-file list, `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (Tier 2), is a mandatory, content-inert recipe-registration carryover from Step 3's original (pre-round) creation, not new work from this round — noted above for transparency, not counted against this round's scope.
